answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, registers a reach, and files a key-bound aerial survey: length, widths, yarrow markers, thread line, and umber post at low point. An auditor recomputes area from length times mean width on the public table, checking thread and umber datum; over 5% deviation, reused reach, or copied hash burns the bond. Fee k is 27+8(k-1): the 1,000th pays 8,019, 1,000 fakes pay 4,023,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-photo ring fails, its photos carrying a foreign key and stamp, mismatching thread and umber markers. An honest identity pays 27 once and recovers its bond.
